framing: Share of crash records by weekday

initial_plan.answerability: yes; crash records can be assigned to weekdays and their shares among in-period records can be calculated
initial_plan.metric: percentage of in-period police-reported crash rows assigned to each weekday
initial_plan.denominator: all crash rows with a nonmissing crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
initial_plan.population: crash rows with a nonmissing crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
initial_plan.grouping: weekday of crash_date, Monday through Sunday

facts.impossible_crash_date_rows: 0; DATE-typed values cannot encode impossible calendar dates
facts.empty_or_unknown_crash_date_values: 0; DATE-typed values can only represent missingness as NULL
facts.year_coverage: Each year 2013–2025 has observed crash-date bounds from January 1 through December 31; bounds alone cannot verify data completeness.

data_check_findings.plan_change: The initial plan pooled the 2013–2025 weekday share. After the check, changed the final grouping to year and weekday, with each year's row total as denominator, to show annual weekday composition separately from changing annual record volume. This uses the same date column, years, and eligible rows checked above.
data_check_findings.implications_and_decisions: Use 2,132,218 rows with dates in 2013–2025; exclude 136,969 dated rows outside the requested years. There are no missing dates, common 0001-01-01, 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, or 2000-01-01 sentinel dates, or missing weekday derivations, so none are dropped or shown as separate groups. DATE typing rules out impossible calendar dates and non-NULL empty/unknown values. Keep all eligible records; disclose that observed bounds span each year but do not prove complete reporting.

final_plan.answerability: yes for the annual weekday composition of police-reported crash records; this does not estimate traffic exposure or crash risk
final_plan.metric: percentage of each year's eligible police-reported crash rows assigned to each weekday
final_plan.denominator: all crash rows with a valid, nonmissing crash_date in that calendar year, separately for each year 2013–2025
final_plan.population: each crash row with a valid, nonmissing crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive; each row counted once
final_plan.grouping: year and weekday derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday
final_plan.limitations: The file has 2,132,218 eligible rows and no missing dates or common 0001-01-01, 1900-01-01, 1970-01-01, or 2000-01-01 sentinel dates; 136,969 dated rows outside the requested years are excluded. Observed crash-date bounds span January 1 through December 31 in every year, but this does not verify complete reporting. Annual shares describe the composition of police-reported records and are not adjusted for exposure or risk; annual row totals also vary substantially.
